answer: Betweenness throttling resists sybils: the few attestation edges linking a sybil region to the honest core act as a bridge with very high betweenness, and the protocol caps how much trust any single high-betweenness edge may carry. A jade-green cluster across the lagoon reachable only over one or two such bridges is choke-limited no matter how many fakes hide behind them. Honest identities sit in richly-connected neighborhoods with low per-edge betweenness, so throttling bridges starves sybils without touching them.
